s: General MCX Technologies Corporation (formerly McorpCX, Inc) (“we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) is currently focused on delivering digital transformation solutions to customer-centric organizations through integrated marketing, data science, analytics, commerce, and machine learning.
